title: Quick-Fix Greek Pork Shoulder Stifado
description: This classic Greek stifado is a hearty and flavorful dish made with pork shoulder, onions, garlic, and a rich beurre monte. It's a quick and easy meal perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the pork shoulder and brown on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the pork from the pot and set aside.
Add the sliced onions to the pot and cook, stirring occasionally, until they're softened and lightly browned, about 15 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Sprinkle the flour over the onions and garlic and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Gradually add 250ml of water to the pot, whisking constantly.
Return the pork shoulder to the pot and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1 hour and 30 minutes, or until the pork is tender.
Remove the pot from the heat and stir in the beurre monte.
Serve the stifado hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley.

Note: Beurre monte is a mixture of 1 part butter and 2 parts water. To make beurre monte, melt 1 tablespoon of butter in a small saucepan over low heat, then whisk in 2 tablespoons of water. Continue to cook, whisking constantly, until the mixture is smooth and hot.
